label: Discretionary closure guidance
initiation: Review workload motivates a proposed change to the contribution guide.
outcome: Two specific provisions enter the guide; an additional no-review suggestion does not appear in the final text.
alternative_explanation: Workload rationale is asserted, and no actual closure under the new permission is observed here.
level_rationale: Revision of recurring review arrangements, with operational conduct as the embedded target.

span.quote:
Trivial pull requests or pull requests that refactor the code with no clear
benefits may be immediately closed by the maintainers to reduce unnecessary
workload on reviewing.
Pull requests that refactor the code should not be made by new contributors.
Any refactoring pull request may be closed when it doesn't attract anyone willing to review.
